newsitem.title: GERMANY: German shares end bourse trade just ahead.
newsitem.headline: German shares end bourse trade just ahead.

text.p: 1310 GMT - German shares ended bourse trade just ahead after they recovered from earlier weakness on higher-than-expected December M3 data at 7.9 pct. Values unruffled by news Bundesbank keeping interest rates unchanged.
* DAX-30 index of leading German shares ends 4.79 points up at 3,033.46, March DAX futures 1.5 points up at 3,044.0.
* Mannesmann off earlier highs after details emerge on newly-named Arcor telecom venture with German railway.
* Degussa off, following post-bourse Wednesday fall.
